semantic_summary: Create reviewable physical-mail drafts from PDFs, letters, document uploads, supported workflow forms, and bulk recipient data. PostalForm helps agents validate mail details, send owners to hosted checkout, track fulfillment, and use MPP or x402 for explicitly authorized machine-paid print-and-mail orders.
use_cases: Create a reviewable checkout draft for mailing a PDF without a printer or post-office trip.
Compose a plain letter or workflow form packet and prepare it for physical postal delivery.
Validate sender, recipient, mail options, and price before a human approves checkout.
Track paid print-and-mail fulfillment status from an agent or automation.
Create an explicitly authorized machine-paid mail order with MPP or x402 after validation.
